missing_policy.features: NaN; empty CSV field; reason in quality_flag. Valid no-SCR: count/rate=0, amplitude mean/max=NaN with no_scr_events.

preprocessing_design.integration_direction: Feature extraction follows Nhu G1 design; no separate preprocessing design by Mai
preprocessing_design.scope: G1 design only; implementation and signal validation belong to G2

filter_implementation.edge_policy: See methods.filter.edges_seconds_each_end; EDA tonic/phasic adds 60 s to the cleaned-signal design

preprocessing_design.acc_temp: Calibrated chest ACC/TEMP kept; wrist ACC /64 to g; S2 suspect chest TEMP masked NaN
preprocessing_design.acc_emg_aggregation: 12 nonoverlapping 5 s blocks inside 60 s; calculate per block then average
preprocessing_design.invalid_samples: Exclude common windows overlapping missing/nonfinite required channels or any required filter edge; feature-level detector/contact failures stay NaN with flags
preprocessing_design.acceptance_scope: User selected Nhu written G1 design as the preprocessing basis; no claim of additional personal confirmation from Nhu or final signal validation

nhu_g1_supplement.scope: G1 design and raw-stat sample acceptance only
nhu_g1_supplement.acc_gravity: retained; unit conversion still requires evidence

acc.scale_conversion: wrist ACC /64 to g; chest already g; see unit_policy

quality_design.s2_chest_temperature_note: mask both S2 chest TEMP features NaN with chest_temp:suspect_contact
quality_design.source_units: documented and sampled on aligned S2; unit_policy fixes adapter boundary

preprocessing_design.feature_design_supplement: methods section in this contract; preserves Nhu EDA/RESP cleaned cutoffs and adds tonic60s edges and feature-specific details

g1_sample_acceptance.scope_note: Raw 21-feature G1 package only; these tolerances are not final tolerances for 68 physiological features

coordination.local_check: Mai checks own S2 package before handoff; not cross-machine acceptance
coordination.cross_machine_comparison: Nhu consolidates ZIP packages according to user team arrangement
coordination.group_acceptance: pending actual comparison across four machines; no certification in this schema

eda_design_evidence.scope: Nam EDA of 112 raw statistics, not physiological acceptance

readiness.meaning: Feature kernels and a reference adapter implement the G1 contract; local package checks do not establish peer review, cross-machine acceptance or physiological signal validity.

unit_policy.source: WESAD original wesad_readme.pdf sections II.1-II.3 and S2_E4_Data.zip/info.txt
unit_policy.chest_pkl: already converted: ECG/EMG mV; EDA uS; TEMP degC; ACC g; RESP percent. Do not apply ADC formulas again.
unit_policy.wrist_pkl: EDA uS; TEMP degC; BVP a.u.; ACC in 1/64 g, divide by 64 once to produce g.
unit_policy.input_boundary: Only official synchronized WESAD PKL is supported. TXT/ZIP ADC values require a separate adapter; never guess units from range.
unit_policy.evidence: unit_policy.unit_evidence embedded in this schema; human summary in docs/G1_HOP_DONG_FEATURE.md
unit_policy.verification_scope: Documentation plus aligned S2 samples, not a fresh audit of all 15 recordings. For other sources require explicit unit declarations.

unit_evidence.scope: Aligned S2 chest 100 samples and wrist first20 samples; sample verification, not all subjects

numeric.band_power: integral of amplitude-signal PSD, not RR spectral HRV; do not call LF/HF

filter.scope: each continuous finite subject segment before slicing; never cross NaN/Inf or concatenate label-separated spans
filter.short_segment: unusable when len<=padlen or no eligible interior after removing edges

ecg.detector: squared detection-band signal; centered 0.10 s boxcar (70 samples), clipped segment boundaries; find_peaks(distance=210,prominence=max(0.5*std(envelope),1e-12)); refine each candidate to argmax(abs(detection_signal)) in +/-0.10 s; unique sorted indices; if refinement distance<0.30 s retain larger absolute peak, ties earlier
ecg.interpretation: ECG RR variability with heuristic artifact rejection; no clinical normal-to-normal classification

bvp.detector: find_peaks on bandpassed BVP, distance=ceil(0.30*64)=20, prominence=max(0.5*std(filtered),1e-12)
bvp.interpretation: pulse rate and PRV; not ECG HRV

cardiac_intervals.rule: RR=diff(peaks)/fs. Stage1 keep 0.30<=RR<=2.00 s. m=median(stage1 RR); Stage2 keep stage1 intervals with abs(RR-m)<=0.20*m, inclusive. No interpolation or filling.
cardiac_intervals.fail: all six rate/interval features NaN; flag device_sensor:insufficient_or_unreliable_beats
cardiac_intervals.pairs: diff(original RR) only where both adjacent original RR pass; never bridge a rejected RR
cardiac_intervals.formula: rate=60/RR; mean/std(rate,ddof=0); mean(RR)*1000; std(RR,ddof=1)*1000; sqrt(mean(adjacent_diff**2))*1000; mean(abs(adjacent_diff)>0.05)

eda.decomposition: tonic=Butterworth4 SOS forward/back lowpass of cleaned EDA; phasic=cleaned-tonic. Explicit filter-based approximation, not cvxEDA.
eda.detector: find_peaks(phasic,distance=ceil(fs*1.0),prominence=0.01). For each peak find last minimum in preceding 4 s (inclusive), capped strictly after previous accepted peak; onset-to-peak amplitude = phasic[peak]-phasic[onset]. Accept when amplitude>=0.01 uS and 0.25<=rise_seconds<=4.0, onset and peak both inside the eligible window.
eda.count_rule: detect on continuous finite segments, assign only complete onset/peak events within [start,end); count each event once per window, overlapping windows may contain same event
eda.no_event: usable signal with no accepted events: count=0,rate=0, amplitude_mean/max=NaN; flag sensor:no_scr_events
eda.unusable: all eight EDA features NaN and flag sensor:flat_or_unusable; never encode detector failure as zero

resp.detector: find_peaks(filtered,distance=ceil(2.0*fs),prominence=max(0.5*std(filtered),1e-12)); use adjacent peaks both in window

psd.input: ECG 5-40 Hz signal and BVP 0.5-5 Hz signal after locked filtering; no extra resampling
psd.integration: numpy.trapezoid(Pxx[low<=f<=high],f[low<=f<=high]); all boundaries lie exactly on 0.25-Hz bins; adjacent bands sharing endpoints do not duplicate area

temp.known_quality: S2 chest TEMP flagged suspect_contact per subject readme: output both chest TEMP features NaN for the whole recording; retain common windows; flag chest_temp:suspect_contact

acc_emg.aggregation: arithmetic mean of all 12 per-block feature values; require all 12 blocks
acc_emg.acc: convert wrist ACC /64 once; chest ACC unchanged; retain gravity; x,y,z,magnitude=sqrt(x*x+y*y+z*z)
acc_emg.missing_block: exclude entire common window; do not nanmean fewer than 12 blocks

qa.common_window_selection: all required channels must cover full window and pass finite/sample/filter-edge checks; reject once for every sensor group, record reason counts
qa.flat_threshold: std(channel)<=1e-10 in calibrated output units. Mark signal-dependent physiological features NaN; do not automatically discard otherwise eligible common windows. ACC/TEMP descriptive values remain defined except known suspect-contact mask.
qa.detector_exception: catch expected detector failure only; mark affected feature group NaN and detector_failure reason; unexpected errors fail run
qa.nonfinite_output: NaN allowed only for declared reasons; Inf raises validation error
qa.flags: unique sorted sensor:reason codes joined by semicolon; if none use heuristic_checks_passed_not_physiological_validation
qa.no_imputation: do not impute during extraction; fit imputer/scaler/selection/resampling on train-fold only

reproducibility.design_choices: Thresholds/algorithms are explicit Mai design choices under user request; peer review and runtime validation are not claimed. Changes require new feature_version.

comparison.nan_masks: exactly equal; equal_nan allowed only when quality reasons match

reproducibility.acceptance: verify implementation on synthetic invariants and physiological S2 before accepting 15-subject extraction; raw 21/112 S2 does not certify this design

change_policy.reason: Explicit PSD bands; RR names avoid falsely asserting ectopic/NN classification; affects only unimplemented physiological schema, not raw outputs
